name: tenet
description: Privacy and AI governance platform for Nigeria, Africa and global regimes

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tenet/core && npm run build -w @tenet/web && npm run build -w @tenet/api

scripts.build:artifact: npm run build -w @tenet/core && npm run build:artifact -w @tenet/web && node scripts/artifact-page.mjs apps/web/dist-artifact/index.html dist-artifact.html
